name: Beren's Peril
summary: Scourge gather in a hidden cave in southern Silverpine Forest, and Shadow Priest Allister moves to stop them. The Forsaken hope to strike before the undead can begin their offensive.

sections.title: A Preemptive Strike
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister hears that servants of the Lich King are gathering deep in southern Silverpine Forest. Their growing numbers threaten Forsaken operations across the region. Allister sends scouts to strike first and destroy the Scourge in their secluded lair before they can mobilize.

sections.title: The Hidden Cave
sections.body: A hidden cave cuts into the hills south of Ambermill, the Dalaran-aligned settlement. The rough slopes make the cavern easy to miss, and the approach lies around the hills’ southern face. Ravenclaw drudgers and guardians dwell inside, remnants of the Scourge whose destruction helps the Forsaken hold their ground in the forest.

faq.answer: Beren's Peril is a secluded cave in the hills of southern Silverpine Forest, south of Ambermill. Ravenclaw undead dwell within.

faq.q: Who assigns the mission to Beren's Peril?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister, stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, sends Horde adventurers after learning that hostile undead are preparing an offensive from the cave.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking the undead there?
faq.answer: The undead in Beren's Peril serve the Lich King as part of the Scourge. The Forsaken broke free of his control and fight to purge his lingering minions from their lands.

faq.q: How do you find the entrance to the cave?
aliases: how to get to berens peril
faq.answer: The cave lies in the hills south of Ambermill. The steep ridges make the southern face the way to reach its entrance.
Scourge thralls dwell in the cave, including Ravenclaw Drudgers and Ravenclaw Guardians. They appear to be gathering for an assault on nearby settlements.

faq.q: What role does Dalaran play in this mission?
faq.answer: Dalaran has no direct role in the mission. Human wizards from Dalaran occupy nearby Ambermill, which Allister uses as a landmark to help scouts find the hidden cave.

angles.text: For you, a Forsaken, rooting out Scourge remnants at Beren's Peril helps defend your people from the Lich King's lingering grasp.
For you in the Horde, clearing hidden Scourge pockets along Silverpine's borders helps stabilize northern Lordaeron.
As a priest, you follow Shadow Priest Allister's orders and help secure the Sepulcher's authority by destroying rival undead horrors.
